homeProjectFormEntry: Open the scenario, then select New project in the project center or Edit from a project menu. The normal product action opens the form.
homeProjectFormExpected: Open the real form from the project center's create action or a project's edit menu. Try validation, submission and cancellation; only current Mock data changes.
homeProjectReadFailed: Project read failure and recovery · {{projects}} projects / {{tasks}} tasks
homeProjectReadLoadingExpected: Project catalog reads take two seconds. The normal workspace loading state appears before projects and tasks, rather than a fake empty project list.
homeProjectReadFailedExpected: Project catalog reads keep returning 503, including reloads. Clear the fault in the workbench, then use the product reload action. Projects, tasks and login are unchanged. Reset rearms the fault.
tryProjectReadLoading: Workspace loading feedback and project catalog recovery
tryProjectReadRecovery: Persistent project read failure, explicit recovery and reload
homeProjectRecoveryScope: Only clears this instance's project read fault. It does not reload. Use Reload in the product afterwards.
tryTaskLoading: Task loading feedback and the resulting list
tryTaskRetry: Real error feedback, retry and task recovery
homeTaskLoadingExpected: Task reads take two seconds. The normal product loading indicator appears before the task list, rather than an empty state.
homeTaskRetryExpected: The initial concurrent task reads return 503 after two seconds. Use the normal retry button to recover. Reset rearms the failure. Only the project-center task catalog request is affected.
tryCrossBatch: Load the full large task list
homeEntry: Choose a project and task data scenario, then use the product's create, search, pagination and open controls. Try empty projects, empty tasks and search with no matches separately.
homeStandardExpected: Projects and tasks share one Mock ledger and can be opened through the product page.
homeBrowseExpected: Browse simulated projects and existing tasks; open a project card to enter its workspace.
homeEmptyExpected: The project list is empty and shows creation guidance without a task region. Create the first project using the product form.
homeNoTasksExpected: With no tasks, hide the task region and expand projects into one column. Keep the task region visible when tasks exist or task loading fails.
homeProjectBoundaryExpected: Use the project pagination controls to check the first page, last page and disabled buttons. Search with no matches is distinct from an empty project list.
homeTaskBoundaryExpected: Use the task pagination controls to check the first and last pages. Every task belongs to an existing project and can be opened.
homeManyProjectsExpected: Search and paginate through multiple project pages, then open a project on the last page.
homeManyTasksExpected: Tasks belong to projects in the same ledger. Browse multiple pages and open an existing task.
homeDenseExpected: Both lists span multiple pages. A project search with no matches is different from an empty project list.
homeLongContentExpected: Project names reach the product form's length limit and tasks have long titles. Check truncation, reachable actions and opening the last page without changing identity or ownership.
homeCrossBatchExpected: The product's session reader fetches tasks across HTTP batches. The per-request batch size is not the total task limit.
homeCreateExpected: Open the product form from the creation guidance and submit a Mock project. Reload keeps it; resetting the scenario restores the initial empty data.
homeOpenProjectExpected: Open a project card, return using the product's project-center navigation, then open the same project again.
homeOpenTaskExpected: Open an existing task from the product list, then return to the project center. Task identity and project ownership remain unchanged.
homeProjectActionsExpected: Hover over a project card to open its menu. Try edit, pin and archive; archiving on the last page keeps the page number valid.
mockLimitation: Only UI consumption of simulated responses is covered, not real services, models, tools or persistence.
registrationLimitation: Catalog registration does not prove integration. Consumer tests and real runtime evidence are required.
homeBrowseLimitation: Loading and read-failure states are not connected yet. This scenario provides normal projects and tasks only.
homeActionsLimitation: Changes affect the Mock ledger only. Reveal in Finder or File Explorer does not perform a real system action.

loginOverride: This scenario fixes its account policy; the global login choice applies to other scenarios.
publicControlScope: Changing login preserves projects and tasks. Only identity is simulated, not real authentication, credits or payments. Theme, language and login choices persist across scenarios in this isolated instance. Changing these controls reloads the page and may discard unsaved input. Reload preserves Mock data; reset restores scenario data without resetting global choices. Fixed account scenarios take precedence over the global login choice.
contentRecoveryScope: Clear the persistent content read fault for this instance's target file only. Do not change files, versions or real disk. Close these controls and retry in the original document; decoding and engine faults are separate.
browsingRecoveryScope: Clear persistent listing or Explorer read faults for this instance's target project only. Files, pagination history and real disk remain unchanged. Close these controls and retry in the original page.
storageRecoveryScope: Clear storage read faults for this instance only, without accessing disk or changing real configuration. Close these controls and retry each source in the original page.
consoleShortcut: Switch between docking and a separate window without rebuilding either page or clearing drafts. Drag the dock's left edge, or focus it and use arrow keys to resize. Press F8 to restore the hidden workbench. Switching or resetting scenarios resets mock data.
nativeRequired: PDFE runs in Electron only. Start it with pnpm ops dev pdfe.
archiveRecoveryScope: Clear the archived-project read fault for this mock instance only, without remounting the page or modifying projects. Close these controls and retry in the original page.
title: PDFE Workbench
materialsDescription: Shared controls, interaction patterns and business components for product prototyping, design and frontend development.
guideNavigation: Expand a page and feature area, then choose a scenario. Continue through the product's own controls to try its interactions. Opening or resetting a scenario restores the Mock data; browsing navigation and reading this guide do not change it.
sharedFunctions: Product managers, designers and frontend engineers see the same features, with no role-specific interface. Knowledge responsibilities and editing scope belong in Agent tasks.
discoveryPlaceholder: Search page, scenario ID or state
roleProductFocus: Focus on requirements, business flows, copy and expected outcomes confirmed by the owning team.
roleDesignFocus: Focus on layout, visuals, component states, themes and keyboard interaction using the real components and tokens.
roleFrontendFocus: Focus on shared page implementation, domain consumers and regression coverage while preserving contracts and ownership.
roleBoundary: All roles can edit code with an Agent. Roles are not permission levels, and context is not a sandbox. Actual changes require task-specific authority and semantic review.
scopeMockDescription: Change only specified samples, copy and existing scenario policies. This does not authorize editing the entire preview directory, simulation engine or isolation boundary.
scopePresentationDescription: Change only the explicitly specified page presentation and interaction. Candidate files may contain other responsibilities; confirm exact files and behavior before editing, without expanding into protocols or global state.
requirementsBoundary: The requirement is the existing product's complete Mock functionality. Check product entry points and Owners; scenario registration does not prove completeness. Copy paths with the context for an Agent; listing them does not mean their contents have been read.
taskPlaceholder: Describe the goal and behavior that must remain unchanged
taskContextBoundary: This is a reviewable context draft, not write authorization. Capture the source revision and existing dirty state, confirm allowed files and verification before editing, and record real product acceptance separately.
description: Shared product UI with isolated simulated data. This is not real feature acceptance.
coverage: Catalog registration does not prove integration or verification. Do not mark missing surfaces as passed.
diagnosticScope: Recent request results and event summaries for this simulated instance only. Credentials, message bodies and file contents are not recorded.
requestFailed: Preview request failed. Check diagnostics or the developer console.
startupFailed: Preview startup failed. Check the preview service and launch logs.
connected: Preview entry available; not all states have been verified.
rendererDemo: Shared renderer UI and isolated callbacks only; not native window lifecycle or real-service acceptance.
directoryScope: Choose a virtual directory in this preview instance only. This does not access local files or grant native permissions. Saving changes mock configuration only; existing projects and files do not move.
hiddenPanelScope: Reuses the registered product module. This container is not the production navigation layout. Close it after an action to inspect the result in the original workspace.
artifactRecoveryScope: Clears only persistent catalogue, history or publication-content read failures in this instance. It does not change snapshots or regenerate files. Close the console and retry through the original page.
browserRecovery: Clear simulated browser policy read failure
browserRecoveryScope: Only clear the current preview instance's persistent policy read failure. Rules, history, native capabilities and real permissions stay unchanged. Close this Console and retry from the original page.
browserSurfaceScope: Reuses the real UI with simulated blank tabs only. Navigation, native content, CDP, menus and downloads are unavailable. This host does not verify production navigation or native windows.
